Viewed enlarged contact sheet containing all 95 extracted glyphs labelled by exact glyph index and input byte.

Compared source PNG alpha to reference alpha over each nonzero alpha bounding box. Reference grayscale RGB and alpha both encode source intensity; using alpha avoids double application of alpha when comparing rendered screenshots.
Selected reference coordinate for tilde explicitly, excluding its accidental occurrence inside equals. Duplicate source glyphs may share the same visual reference.
limitations: Reference agreement validates artwork and intensity only; glyph positioning, advance, and line extent require renderer-code evidence.
Absence from this reference sheet is not evidence of a missing or defective extracted glyph.
Font RLE archive and input-byte map are independent of the HUD compressed-size-table ID bug; no source mapping changes are indicated by this review.
PNG transparency can make white glyphs invisible in viewers with a white backdrop; review used an opaque dark inspection backdrop without changing deliverable images.

hud_menu_details.comparison_method: Reassembled 32x32 RGBA32 TMEM tiles from indexed runtime resources; verified all 49 raw payloads directly against current retail US ROM with validated loader; exact RGB equality for every opaque source pixel against reference positions. Reticle has no fully opaque pixels: its maximum-alpha pixels were compared. This establishes cropped artwork identity, not runtime placement.

generic_texture_export_check.scope: Recursive decoded hash check through records in existing top-level build/assets/textures/*/manifest.json in primary checkout
generic_texture_export_check.limit: No global scan of every image file or arbitrary nested manifest; absence stated for these known manifests only.

hud_menu_details.summary_scope: Historical missing-group counts before the approved export batch; all 18 verified groups are now exported.

intro_text_beta_details.scope: Reverse reference-sheet coverage for Intro Credits, Text, ECTS menu, and 2D Villager. Current reviewed HUD and font galleries plus a bounded check of existing standalone texture PNG exports.
method: Viewed all four complete sheets and enlarged text/button/effect regions.
Read current manifests: 92 HUD selectors, 22 additional groups, 95 main-font glyphs.

Compared existing standalone texture PNGs (us, us-native-proven, us-ci8-proven, us-rgba16-proven, us-1056-proven, us-tiled-views) using exact foreground RGB anchors and visually rejected accidental white-on-white matches. No additional genuine coverage was established by this bounded check.
Used existing exact font evidence for main glyphs; this is distinct from compact block font and ordinal suffix art.
limitations: Missing means absent from the reviewed named galleries and no match established in the bounded existing-export audit; it does not prove absence from every US ROM resource.
Visual family matches do not prove every brightness/orientation variant or runtime composition.

other_sheet_details.method: Contact-sheet visual review followed by bounded masked template search with 5-bit RGB comparisons, native orientation and vertical flip. Candidate photo matches were then confirmed against all 4096 RGB pixels without quantization: zero mismatches.
other_sheet_details.identity_caveat: The existing standalone texture export manifests use physical stream ordinal flat_index fields. Reported runtime IDs for positive matches were independently reconciled by compressed ROM extents against the validated indexed loader. This is an identifier caveat, not a claim that every existing texture image is wrong.
